summary: SYN-09 requests DocSpace Plus (DocSpace, Knowledge Management) at $3000/year for 12 Marketing users as a shared wiki. The same vendor's DocSpace (SW004) is already Approved, company-wide with 200 licensed seats, and covers the requester's department, so this is an existing-tool overlap. Budget is sufficient (available $15000 vs $3000), vendor registry and risk records are favourable, and the request carries no instruction-like text. evaluate_policy returned baseline label 'Review existing tool before new purchase' with required approvals Department Head and Procurement.
concerns: find_existing_software shows DocSpace (SW004) is Approved, Company-wide with 200 licensed seats and covers_requester_department=true, matching on same_vendor, same_product and same_category.
The stated use case (shared wiki for marketing team notes and launch checklists) appears satisfiable by the existing DocSpace licence; the request does not state what DocSpace Plus adds beyond it.
get_vendor_risk reports processes_personal_data=true for DocSpace, though the request's data_access_level is internal_marketing and no personal data classes were revealed in the free text.

The justification (a shared wiki for marketing notes and launch checklists) names no capability the existing tool lacks, so no credible gap is evidenced.
